title: NJ Talingting
text:
I build open-source software that resolve the “Continental Fallacy”— the systemic bias that treats our oceans as barriers rather than conductors of connectivity in spatial modeling.
My lived experience beside the heart of the maritime logistics in the Philippines has led me to developing packages now indexed on the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) while handling administrative roles as an appointed public official since 2023.
Beyond package development, I’ve architected and maintain PinasR, a centralized registry for open-sourced packages made by Filipino R developers to make reproducible research accessible for all.

title: Recognition
text:
** Tunay na Iskolar ng Bayan Scholarship Recipient** (2020)

Selected for a fully funded scholarship to pursue Cambridge IGCSE and A-Levels at a British International School.
Granted the opportunity to undergo rigorous Cambridge IGCSE and A-Level styling in Cebu, Philippines. This international training instilled a deep global research perspective and molded my trajectory to pursue early, highly specialized technical disciplines.
